rationale: Adds a learned per-channel scale after the final RMSNorm, initialized to the current behavior, so the tied output path gets cheap export-surviving channel calibration without changing data flow, recurrence, evaluation, or wallclock rules. This spends only 512 FP32 control parameters on the scored output geometry and keeps the 9x512 reverse-tail curriculum and final exact int8+zlib path intact.
title: Final RMS Output Scale
